neighbours.label: words ending in -oid, whether the ending is its own token or not (asteroid, humanoid, opioid, hemorrhoid, fibroid)
fire: Astronomers tracked the asteroid for several months.
Her new book is about a humanoid nurse.
The clinic treats opioid addiction among veterans.
A small fibroid showed up on the scan.
He bought a cream for a painful hemorrhoid.
That tabloid paid a lot for the photos.
She grew paranoid after the break-in.
The robot looks like a humanoid at first.
quiet: Astronomers tracked the comet for several months.
Her new book is about a young nurse.
The clinic treats alcohol addiction among veterans.
A small solid mass showed up on the scan.
He bought a cream for a painful rash.
That paper paid a lot for the photos.
She tried to avoid him after the break-in.
The robot looks like a toy at first.

notes: Second round. The first round ('the piece oid') failed because whole-token words fired: asteroid 0.51, opioid 0.76, thyroid 0.25. ' thyroid' and ' steroids' stayed weak in the probes (0.16-0.18), so those are left out and reported here. ' void' 0.14 and ' avoid' 0.07.
